title: Astro Drift: Sector Zero
description: Pilot a thrust-vectored starfighter through high-density asteroid fields. Chain plasma combos, trigger phase dashes through debris, and survive escalating cosmic storms.
instructions: Use WASD or Arrow keys to steer and thrust. Press Space to fire dual plasma cannons, Shift to trigger an invulnerable phase dash, and P or Esc to pause.

title: Horizon Runner 3D
description: High-speed 3D synthwave canyon racer. Weave between monolith barriers, hit overdrive pads, and maintain momentum as the horizon accelerates.
instructions: Steer left and right across the 3D canyon lanes using A/D or Left/Right arrows. Hold W or Up Arrow for overdrive boost to multiply your score per kilometer.
controls: A / D or Left / Right: Lane Shift

title: Tactical Grid: Pulse
description: Precision spatial block puzzle on a reactive power matrix. Place polyomino energy conduits to complete horizontal and vertical circuits before the grid locks.
instructions: Click any of the three conduit blueprints in your dock, then click a valid cell on the 8x8 matrix to lock it in. Clear full rows or columns to trigger chain multipliers.

title: Citadel Bastion Defense
description: Command an arcane frontier outpost against waves of swarmers, iron golems, and void kiters. Construct rotary pulse turrets and frost pylons along the canyon road.
instructions: Select a tower blueprint from the bottom tactical dock (1: Pulse Turret, 2: Frost Pylon, 3: Heavy Mortar) and click any glowing build socket along the road.
controls: Mouse Click: Build Tower on Socket
